name: MetricCard
description: Compact card displaying a labelled metric value with optional highlight and transparency states

props.name: label
props.description: Text label shown above the value

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit suffix appended after the value (e.g. `"TH/s"`, `"W"`, `"USD"`)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names appended to the root element

props.name: noMinWidth
props.description: Removes the default minimum width so the card shrinks to content

props.name: isValueMedium
props.description: Applies a medium-weight variant to the value typography

props.name: isHighlighted
props.description: Renders the value in orange to draw attention

props.name: showDashForZero
props.description: Displays `—` instead of `0` when value is zero

props.name: isTransparentColor
props.description: Renders the value in a low-opacity white for de-emphasized display
